    Flex Up 75% Partial Refund Add-On

    Flex Up 75% Partial Refund Add-On

    The Flex Up refund protection optional add-on offers a 75% partial refund, giving you financial security against life’s unexpected moments, allowing you to commit to your event with confidence. This affordable add-on lets you secure a higher value partial refund, with the flexibility to redeem it up to 7 days before race day - no questions asked.

    Refund option
    Flex Up 75% partial refund add-on is available at time of purchase only. Learn more about this here. If you do not choose to purchase Flex Up, standard refund and withdrawal terms apply (Athlete Withdrawal Policy).

  • Image

    Buy Now, Pay Later

    Buy Now, Pay Later

    Training for race day starts with registration. To give athletes more flexibility, IRONMAN offers Buy Now, Pay Later options through Klarna, Afterpay, and Affirm.

    If eligible, you may be able to spread the cost of your registration over time instead of paying the full amount upfront. During checkout, you'll be able to review available payment plans and choose the option that works best for you.

    Available payment options

     

     

    Approval, eligibility, payment schedules, fees, and applicable terms are determined by the selected provider and will be presented before you complete your purchase. 

    CA resident loans made or arranged pursuant to a California Financing Law license. NMLS # 1353190

  • Image

    World Championship Qualifier

    World Championship Qualifier

    Image

    For many athletes, qualifying for an IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship is the ultimate goal. It's the opportunity to test yourself against the best athletes from around the world and earn a place on triathlon's biggest stage.

    This event offers qualifying slots to the 2028 IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship.

Registration information

  • Bib numbers will be assigned dynamically onsite upon attendance at Athlete Check-In.  
  • Athletes who register within 45 days of the event date will not have their name appear on the merchandise apparel.  
  • You will be required to purchase a USAT membership if you do not have a membership that is valid through the race date.
  • Athletes must be 18 years of age on race day.  
  • This event offers slots to the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship. 

Withdrawal options are based on the date you registered for this event. Learn more about North American event withdrawal policies.   

Online registrations are synced to our database within 24 hours. You will automatically receive a registration confirmation e-mail from our registration partner.  
 
Your age group category for the event you registered for will be reflective of your age as of 31 December of the event year. 

You can sign in to your IRONMAN profile to check your registration status at any time, below: 
My IRONMAN profile >> 

Your name, and the names of other starters will be searchable on the IRONMAN Tracker App the day prior to your race.

Upon registration, the team captain will be asked to create a team, providing a team name and add at minimum 1 team member to claim the entry. 

The team members that are sent a “Claim” from the relay captain at the time of registration can register through the Claim email. 

To add team members after this, the team captain can email the event email address, and the new team member will be sent an email to register to the team at checkout, the captain will be required to pay the full registration fee. 

During the registration process, team members might need to purchase a one day license depending on the federation requirements of the country the race takes place.
